main_body: Round leaf canopy (rows ~0-31) on a short trunk with a grass base patch
top_band: Lighter green mid-canopy highlight clumps (rows ~2-14) blend into the canopy; no distinct flat top band, volume is shaded as a rounded organic mass
evidence: Organic canopy is a rounded mass lit from above, with lighter clumps at the top and darker underside shading, plus a trunk and ground patch. It reads as a 3/4 tree, not a flat elevation. There are no hard-edged horizontal surfaces to fail, and the dark underside of the canopy over the trunk acts as the eave shadow.

style.evidence: The canopy has about 5 green steps in blocky clumps with a dark green-teal outline, which is material-tinted rather than black. It is larger and chunkier than the references, with pixel-blocky clumps and no leaf-level dotting or per-leaf highlights. The trunk is narrow with only 3-4 tones and no roots or branches. The lower canopy has some larger flat mid-green patches. It is somewhat thinner than the reference trees but not a sticker look.
